name: Cheech & Chong - 2g Disposable Vapes - Watermelon Juice
description:
Juicy, sweet, and refreshingly smooth. The Cheech & Chong Watermelon Juice disposable packs 2 grams of premium oil — a distillate base blended with terpenes — into a sleek, ready-to-go device. No cartridges, no setup, no fuss. Just draw and enjoy.

Watermelon Juice delivers pure summer refreshment: ripe, sweet watermelon up front with a bright, thirst-quenching snap and a clean, crisp finish. It's a light, taste-forward profile made for anyone who likes their sessions sweet, easy, and refreshing.

Why you'll love it:

2G total oil — premium distillate blended with terpenes for full flavor
Rechargeable, all-in-one design — draw-activated, pocket-friendly, zero maintenance
Signature Watermelon Juice flavor — ripe, sweet watermelon with a crisp, refreshing finish
Smooth, consistent pulls — flavorful from the first draw to the last
Cheech & Chong — a name that's been in the game since day one

Refreshing flavor, dependable performance, and effortless convenience in one compact device. Cheech & Chong Watermelon Juice is ready whenever you are.

For adult use only. Must be 21+. Keep out of reach of children and pets.
